# pystac-ext-mlm

[PySTAC](https://pypi.org/project/pystac/) extension package for the [Machine Learning Model Extension](https://github.com/stac-extensions/mlm).
This extension provides fields for describing machine learning models, including model architecture, framework, input/output structure, training details, and runtime information.

## Supported versions

- [v1.4.0](https://stac-extensions.github.io/mlm/v1.4.0/schema.json)
- [v1.3.0](https://stac-extensions.github.io/mlm/v1.3.0/schema.json)
- [v1.2.0](https://stac-extensions.github.io/mlm/v1.2.0/schema.json)
- [v1.1.0](https://stac-extensions.github.io/mlm/v1.1.0/schema.json)
- [v1.0.0](https://stac-extensions.github.io/mlm/v1.0.0/schema.json)

## Versioning

This package's MAJOR and MINOR versions match the version of the extension itself, e.g. **pystac-ext-mlm** v1.4.0 corresponds to the [v1.4.0](https://github.com/stac-extensions/mlm/releases/tag/v1.4.0) release of the **mlm** extension.
When we release updates to the package code without changing the target extension version, we use [PATCH releases](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/discussions/versioning/#valid-version-numbers).
